label: Nested exhaustive type cutoffs give every positive rational relative frequency
paraphrase: For positive naturals a and b, retaining the first a(n+1) instances of one type and b(n+1) of the other gives nested finite stages that eventually include every instance, and the uniform relative count of the first type is a/(a+b) at every stage.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: A physically warranted cutoff or regularization that fixes the residual observational likelihood used in the fine-tuning comparison, then the existing designer inference and identification with GOD_4.
connection_plan.blocker: The control shows only that nested exhaustive enumerations of one infinite roster do not fix a frequency; it neither selects nor refutes any physical cutoff measure.
